Configuration

Environment variables

Set TOOL_TIMEOUT to change the timeout (default 30 seconds).

VariableDefaultDescription
TOOL_TIMEOUT30Seconds before a request is abandoned
TOOL_RETRIES1Retries for transient errors

Example

export TOOL_TIMEOUT=10
tool run --retries=2   # two retries
	indented with a tab
  1. Install the tool.
  2. Export the variables.
    • Use a .env file for local runs.
  3. Run it.

Note: values are read once at start-up.
